story: Nā Pali Coast State Park is a 6,175-acre state park located in Hawaii on the northwest side of Kauaɵi. Formed five million years ago, it features cliffs rising up to 4,000 feet above the Pacific Ocean.
matters: The state park was formed to protect the Kalalau Valley. To the east, it connects to the Hono O Nā Pali State Natural Reserve.
name: Nā Pali Coast State Park
